_readme: Physical model parameters for the MuJoCo arm simulation (M1 rework, 2026-10-27).
Single source of truth for the physical model. Controller parameters are NOT stored here;
they come from App/application/s5_site.c and the firmware CMake options through the bridge DLL.
status: measured = real measurement or read from the user's CAD, estimated = rough estimate,
assumed = modelling assumption, user = user decision. Nothing here is validated on hardware.
Human = MyoSim 0.2.3 myoarm_r; exoskeleton = user's Fusion export model/orthoease/orthoease.xml (read-only copy).

meta.coordinate_convention: MyoArm world frame: z up, the person faces -y, right side = -x. Joint angles: 0 = arm hanging straight, positive = flexion (shoulder forward, elbow bend), matching the firmware zero and sign.

timestep_s.source: physics step; controller periods come from the bridge

myo_sim_model.source: user 2026-10-26: use the MuJoCo/MyoSuite human model (MyoSim 0.2.3, Apache-2.0)

shoulder_plane_rad.source: MoBL elv_angle 90 deg = elevation in the flexion (sagittal) plane; baked into the body orientation

lock_shoulder_girdle.source: MyoArm couples clavicle/scapula to shoulder_elv, moving the shoulder centre ~3.8 cm over 0-90 deg; locked so the exoskeleton shoulder axis stays coaxial (first version)

remove_muscles.source: user 2026-10-26: first version without muscles; human effort = joint torque

upper_arm_radius_m.source: inner arc of cuff 03C in model/orthoease/docs/cuff_sections.png (chord ~66 mm, sagitta ~10.8 mm); distance from arm centre to the cuff inner surface

forearm_radius_m.source: inner arc of cuff 08A in cuff_sections.png (chord ~53 mm, sagitta ~11 mm)

shoulder_torque_limit_nm.source: actuator range for the human joint torque, only bounds the PD controller

abs_density_kg_m3.source: UltiMaker ABS TDS v5, 1.1 g/cm3; print list asks for 100% infill (Q4 user decision: STL volume x ABS)

shoulder_motor_mass_kg.source: GIM6010-8 388 g, hardware reference 5.2; sits on the passive turntable, not on the shoulder link

elbow_motor_mass_kg.source: bare M3508 120 g, hardware reference 6.2; whole motor lumped on the upper-arm link at the housing mesh

match_human_upper_arm.source: Q1 user 2026-10-27: lengthen along the 04 adjustment rail so the exoskeleton elbow axis meets the MyoArm elbow (0.257 -> ~0.29 m); real rail travel not verified

shoulder_damping_nms_rad.source: package value 2 N*m*s/rad is a placeholder that would drag the arm; GIM6010-8 back-drive friction unknown, calibrate in M5

elbow_damping_nms_rad.source: package placeholder 1.5 replaced; unknown, calibrate in M5

yaw_damping_nms_rad.source: Q2 user 2026-10-27: passive turntable J01 stays free with a small damping

shoulder_range_deg.source: upper 110 = power-off free range measured 2026-10-16 (package uses 0-110); lower -20 = firmware s5_site.c soft edge, the 0 mark is not a mechanical stop

elbow_range_deg.source: upper 110 measured free range; lower -30 = firmware lower edge (hanging forearm reached -8.9 deg on the bench)

motor_torque_limit_nm.source: simulation actuator range only; the firmware caps (205 mNm rotor x 8, 20 A x 0.02) are applied by the bridge

height_m.source: user 2026-10-27 (second decision): back to the 0.90 m operating-table height and keep the stand pole; a straight-arm forward swing then meets the table edge at about 6.5 deg, which the lift sequence shows

depth_y_m.source: front-back size, extends forward (-y) from the near edge

center_x_m.source: table centred slightly right of the body so the stand block sits on it

edge_clearance_m.source: gap between the hanging arm surface and the table near edge

collision_enabled.source: user 2026-10-27: keep the collision and accept that a straight-arm lift meets the table (no more layout tuning for it). Set false only for a deliberate free-space task, e.g. reproducing the S5 straight sweep

block_height_m.source: fixed seat on the table edge (user sketch 2026-10-26)

block_inset_m.source: length of the seat resting on the table behind the near edge

pole_diameter_m.source: user 2026-10-27: the stand tube is 14 mm and fits the 01B clamp bore

clamp_bore_fusion_xy.source: 01b_stand_clamp.stl cross-section: round enclosed hole (circularity 1.01, radius 7.5 mm = dia 15.0 mm) at the same centre in all 12 z slices; `build_model.clamp_bore()` recomputes it and `check_static.py` compares. The pole axis goes through it

mount.note: The pole runs vertically through the 01B clamp bore of the Fusion model down to the seat; its length is derived (table top + seat to the clamp), so the seat + pole height equals the table-to-shoulder-axis height (D4).

solref_timeconst_s.source: Fusion package README suggestion; soft velcro band, scan in M5 before quoting forces

torquescale.source: Fusion package README suggestion: the band mostly transmits force, little torque
